content_fields.title: Test if container CPU priority is appropriately set (Docker)
content_fields.description: Set an explicit CPU allocation so one container cannot starve the others.
content_fields.finding: Neither cpu_shares nor cpus is set, so the container competes for host CPU without bound.
content_fields.current_code:
web:
    build: .
    command: bash -c "alembic upgrade head && uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8091 --workers 1 --reload"
    volumes:
      - ./app/:/app/
    ports:
      - 8091:8091
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    privileged: true
    cap_add:
      - SYS_ADMIN
content_fields.required_fix:
# docker-compose.yml
  web:
    cpus: 2.0
    cpu_shares: 1024
  db:
    cpus: 1.0
    cpu_shares: 512
criteria: Each service declares an explicit CPU limit or share.
`docker inspect` reports a non-zero NanoCpus or CpuShares.
